title: warm syrian potatoes bake
description: a comforting syrian dish featuring red potatoes, perfect for a chilly evening. fluffy on the inside and crispy on the outside, this warm potatoes bake is a delightful treat.

ingredients.name: 2 kg red potatoes, peeled and halved

instructions: place the potato halves in a large bowl and drizzle with olive oil. mix to combine, ensuring the potatoes are evenly coated.
sprinkle the chopped onion and minced garlic over the potatoes and mix well.
season with cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper, and mix again.
transfer the potatoes to a baking dish and top with grated kasseri cheese.
sprinkle chopped parsley over the top and set aside.
in a small bowl, mix together flour and a pinch of water to create a slurry.
brush the slurry over the potatoes to help them brown in the oven.
bake for 45 minutes or until the potatoes are tender and the top is golden brown.
remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
